title: comment_posted
description: The loop posted a park's question or a wait's conditions on the issue; the event is written once the comment exists. It joins the transition that entered the state by (repo, issue, life, seq). Count one per (repo, issue, life, seq): the same comment can be seen by more than one device. No producer writes it yet.

life.description: The life the comment belongs to.

seq.description: The seq of the transition whose entry action posted the comment.
